{{Top|leg}}
The '''HU-OC deflector shield''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] system produced by [[Prexton]] during the [[Galactic War]]. The HU-OC was often tuned beyond official specifications, offering very strong protection in exchange for a slow regeneration rate; [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] could also overcharge the shield for a brief period.
